unit_name: Kampfgruppe 265th Infantry Division (name of commander not given)
notes: Kampfgruppe from Brittany: Dollmann ordered 275th and 265th mobile Kampfgruppen to prepare to move on 6 June; original orders to move the 265th unit by train cancelled 7 June to save trains for Kampfgruppe Heintz; unit later committed in the Prétot area south of the Douve.
